name: 駅前
description: The square in front of a small train station. The station building has a big clock on its tower and a blue sign. A woman in a beige coat is walking out of the station, pulling a pink suitcase. A man in a dark suit is waiting at the bus stop and looking at his phone. A yellow taxi is waiting on the road next to a crosswalk. There is a clock on a pole in the square, a red vending machine, a blue bicycle, trees in round planters, flower beds, and street lamps.

elements.label: 駅前で
elements.accept: station, train station, in front of the station

elements.label: 女性
elements.accept: woman, lady
elements.partial: a person or someone walking out of the station

elements.label: 男性
elements.accept: man, businessman, a man in a suit
elements.partial: a person or someone waiting at the bus stop

elements.label: 女性がスーツケースを引いている
elements.accept: the woman is pulling or carrying a suitcase, e.g. a traveler with her luggage
elements.partial: mentions a suitcase or luggage without connecting it to the woman

elements.label: 男性がバス停で携帯を見ている
elements.accept: the man is looking at or using his phone, e.g. while waiting at the bus stop
elements.partial: mentions a phone, or says the man is waiting at the bus stop, without saying he is looking at the phone

elements.label: タクシー
elements.accept: taxi, cab, a yellow car
elements.partial: car, vehicle

name: 縄跳び
description: A glowing hologram on a black background. A girl with purple hair tied in a bun, wearing a pink top, green shorts and yellow sneakers, is jumping rope on a glowing pink and blue ring. The bright blue rope is passing under her feet while she is in the air. At the same time, a small orange dog next to her is jumping too, in time with her. A yellow neon counter floating above them shows the number 100, and small colorful lights are floating around them. The whole scene is slowly turning around.

elements.label: 女の子
elements.accept: girl, young woman, woman, a girl with her hair in a bun
elements.partial: a person or someone

elements.label: 女の子が縄跳びをしている
elements.accept: the girl is jumping rope or skipping rope
elements.partial: mentions a rope or jumping, without saying she is jumping rope

elements.label: 跳んでいる間に縄が足の下を通る
elements.accept: the rope is passing under her feet while she is in the air, e.g. she jumps over the rope
elements.partial: says the rope is moving or swinging, without saying it passes under her feet

elements.label: 犬
elements.accept: dog, puppy, a small orange dog
elements.partial: animal, pet

elements.label: 犬も女の子と同時に跳んでいる
elements.accept: the dog is jumping at the same time as the girl, e.g. together with her or in time with her
elements.partial: says the dog is jumping or is next to her, without connecting the two

elements.label: 上の数字が 100 を示している
elements.accept: a counter or number above them shows 100 (one hundred), e.g. she has jumped 100 times
elements.partial: mentions a number, a counter or 100, without saying what it shows or where it is
